assertion.statement: Strimzi 0.46.0 no longer supports ZooKeeper-based Apache Kafka clusters or KRaft migration.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The evidence does not say which resource field, annotation or setting marks a cluster as ZooKeeper-based or mid-migration, so no exposure condition can be written from it.; consequence: The evidence says support was removed but not what happens to an existing ZooKeeper-based cluster or an unfinished KRaft migration after the upgrade (for example, whether the upgrade is blocked, the resources are rejected or the clusters stop being reconciled).
